page_title: Redis Insight - Free GUI & CLI Tool for Redis

sources.entry: Redis Insight - Official Redis tool for browsing, debugging, and visualizing data. ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.name: Redis Insight
summary.one_liner: Redis Insight is Redis's free official GUI and CLI developer tool for browsing, debugging, and visualizing data in Redis databases.
use_cases: Browsing and editing Redis key-value data
Debugging slow or problematic Redis commands
Visualizing Redis Streams and consumer groups
Analyzing Redis memory usage and data type distribution
Building Redis queries with natural language
Running Redis commands from a CLI inside a GUI
summary.what_it_does: Redis Insight provides a graphical interface and an advanced command-line interface (Workbench) for working with Redis data. Users can browse, filter, and edit key-value data with CRUD and batch support, and view data through formatters such as JSON, MessagePack, HEX, and ASCII. Troubleshooting tools include slow log inspection, command profiling, and a database analyzer covering memory, data types, and security metrics. It also offers visualization of Redis Streams and Pub/Sub, schema-aware auto-completion, vector search support, and Redis Copilot, an AI chatbot that answers Redis questions and builds queries from natural language.
notable: Official Redis tool supporting Redis Software, Redis Cloud, Community Edition, and other Redis-compatible products
Redis Copilot AI assistant that builds queries from natural language
Redis for VS Code plugin and Redis Data Integration (RDI) pipeline support
caveats: Redis Cloud console access is currently limited to the Redis Essentials tier
Redis Data Integration and the VS Code plugin are described as separate capabilities and may not be part of the core desktop app
